issue_context.title: Improve EmaCrossUniverseSelectionAlgorithm example.
issue_context.body:
#### Expected Behavior
`EmaCrossUniverseSelectionAlgorithm` includes History Request calls to warm up the indicators.

#### Actual Behavior
`EmaCrossUniverseSelectionAlgorithm` does not warm up the indicators.

#### Potential Solution
Implement historical data requests in `EmaCrossUniverseSelectionAlgorithm`. This implementation needs to be smart because one history request call per security cause time out in live mode.

#### Checklist
- [x] I have completely filled out this template
- [x] I have confirmed that this issue exists on the current `master` branch
